en.title: How did the "TapTap Play Festival" come about?
en.summary: On September 12th and 13th, the first "TapTap Play Festival" was successfully held in Hall A of the Shanghai West Bund Art Center Exhibition Hall. This is a small game exhibition for players. It coincides with TapTap's tenth anniversary. Although the event held at this time is brand new, it has a sense of closure. This feeling is especially strong when I am on site. In addition to providing a place for everyone to try out games and communicate at the booth, the "Play Festival" also reflects a change - TapTap is no longer just the mobile game platform we are familiar with.
